panel.title: Qeet AI
panel.checking: Checking whether Qeet AI is on
panel.statusFailed: Couldn't check whether Qeet AI is on

off.title: Qeet AI is off
off.none: No AI provider is connected for this organisation, and Qeet ID has no Qeet-managed one to fall back on.
off.plan: Your plan doesn't include the Qeet-managed AI provider. Connect your organisation's own provider to use Qeet AI on any plan.
off.askAdmin: An administrator can connect one in Settings › Qeet AI.

start.title: Ask about this organisation
start.intro: Qeet AI looks up people, the audit log and your own sessions, checks who can do what, and writes Terraform and API examples, with your permissions. It can't make changes: it tells you where to make them.

prompts.roleChanges: Show the latest changes to roles and permissions
prompts.leastPrivilegeRole: Draft a least-privilege role for support engineers

start.whereOwn: It sees the page you're on. Messages go to {{provider}}, on your organisation's account.
start.whereQeet: It sees the page you're on. Messages go to {{provider}}, on Qeet's account.

composer.label: Message Qeet AI
composer.placeholder: e.g. What changed in the audit log today?
composer.note: Qeet AI reads and explains; it can't change anything. It can be wrong, so check before you act.

toolCallCard.nothingWasChangedThe: Nothing was changed: Qeet AI can't make changes in this version.
toolCallCard.secretNotice: Shown once, and never sent to Qeet AI's provider. Copy it now and store it safely.

errors.capabilityDenied: This needs the {{capability}} permission, which your account doesn't have.
errors.invalidInput: Qeet AI sent input this tool doesn't accept.
errors.timedOut: It took too long and was stopped.
errors.unknownTool: Qeet AI asked for a tool that doesn't exist.

results.clientRegisteredWithSecret: OAuth client “{{name}}” registered. Copy its secret now: it can't be shown again.
results.secretRotated: Client secret rotated for {{clientId}}. Copy the new secret now: it can't be shown again.
results.strictMfaEnabled: Strict MFA is on: every sign-in must complete MFA.
results.strictMfaDisabled: Strict MFA is off: a remembered device can skip MFA.
results.userCreatedWithRole: User {{email}} created and given the requested role.
results.userSuspended: User {{userId}} suspended: they can no longer sign in.
results.userReactivated: User {{userId}} reactivated: they can sign in again.
results.mfaReset: MFA reset for user {{userId}}: they'll be asked to enrol again.

historyPanel.label: Conversation history
historyPanel.kept: Kept in this browser for 30 days, only for you in this organisation. Signing out clears it.
historyPanel.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and its messages are removed from this browser. This can't be undone.

chat.turnFailed: Qeet AI couldn't finish this answer.

stream.conversationUnavailable: Qeet AI couldn't start this conversation on the server.

createUser.body: Qeet AI will create a new user account in this tenant.

updateUser.body: Qeet AI will change this user's profile.

disableUser.body: This will immediately block the user from signing in. They can be re-enabled later.

enableUser.body: This re-activates the user and restores their ability to sign in.

deleteUser.body: This deletes the user. They can be restored from Deleted users until they're purged.

resetUserMfa.title: Reset MFA
resetUserMfa.body: This clears every MFA factor they've set up. They must set one up again at their next sign-in.

createOrganization.body: Qeet AI will create a new organisation.

createRole.body: Qeet AI will create a new role in this organisation.

assignRole.title: Assign role
assignRole.body: This grants the role's permissions to the user — a privilege change.

grantPermission.body: This broadens what every user holding the role can do — a privilege change.

setStrictMfa.enforceBody: Every member will be required to complete MFA on each sign-in.
setStrictMfa.disableBody: This weakens tenant security: members will be able to skip MFA on trusted devices.

createOAuthClient.body: This registers a new OAuth/OIDC client. Confidential clients mint a client secret shown once.

rotateOAuthClientSecret.title: Rotate client secret
rotateOAuthClientSecret.body: The existing client secret will stop working immediately. Update your application before confirming. The new secret is shown once only.

rotateSigningKeys.body: Signing keys rotate by deployment, not from the console. Nothing will be changed.

settings.title: Qeet AI
settings.description: The assistant in the top bar, and the AI provider it runs on.
settings.noAccessText: Seeing them needs access to the organisation's secrets.

provider.title: Provider
provider.ownText: Every request goes from Qeet ID to this provider, with your key. Everyone in this organisation can use Qeet AI, with their own permissions.
provider.platformText: Qeet AI runs on the Qeet-managed provider, which your plan includes. Connect your own to run it on your organisation's account.
provider.platformExcluded: Qeet AI is off: your plan doesn't include the Qeet-managed provider. Your own provider works on any plan.
provider.noneText: Qeet AI is off until you connect a provider. Qeet ID has no Qeet-managed one to fall back on, so this is the same on every plan.
provider.noneLine: Anthropic, OpenAI, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as Azure.
provider.readOnly: You can see this setting. Changing it needs permission to manage the organisation's secrets.

form.connectText: Use an API key from your organisation's own provider account.
form.changeText: Enter the key again: the saved one is never shown or sent back.
form.anthropicLine: Claude models, at api.anthropic.com unless you set a base URL.
form.openaiLine: GPT models, at api.openai.com/v1 unless you set a base URL.
form.azureLine: Azure OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible service, at your base URL.
form.modelHint: The suggested model, or your own model ID.
form.keyHint: Write-only: it's encrypted and never shown again.
form.baseUrlHint: For a gateway or a self-hosted service. It must be on the public internet.
form.baseUrlAzure: Your Azure OpenAI or compatible endpoint, on the public internet.
form.testPassedOff: Save to turn Qeet AI on.
form.testRefused: The provider didn't accept these settings. Check the key, model and base URL.
form.testNote: Testing sends one request to the provider with this key. Nothing is saved until you save.
form.savedOn: Saved. Qeet AI is on for everyone in this organisation.
form.saved: Saved. Qeet AI now uses these settings.

validation.url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address, without a user name or password in it.
validation.tokens: Enter a whole number from 1 to 200,000.

remove.title: Remove the provider key?
remove.fallback: Qeet AI moves to the Qeet-managed provider where your plan includes it; otherwise it turns off for everyone in this organisation until a new key is saved.
remove.unavailable: Qeet AI turns off for everyone in this organisation until someone connects a provider again. Their past conversations stay in their browsers.

data.title: What leaves Qeet ID
data.toProviderText: What people ask, and where they are in the console: the page, what it has selected and their permissions. What Qeet AI looks up goes with email and IP addresses masked. The provider's own data policy applies.
data.keyText: Encrypted and tied to this organisation. It's never shown again or sent back to the console; only its last four characters are.
data.costText: Billed to your provider account. The reply limit caps each answer's size, and so its cost.
data.auditText: Each message, each look-up Qeet AI asks for and each change to this key is recorded.

qeetAi.title: Qeet AI
qeetAi.description: The assistant and the AI provider it runs on.
